{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Threepio and Artoo, this may look like a meteor, but it's actually your landing pod. Admiral Ackbar and his fellow Calamarians built this especially for your mission.|Mon Mothma, to C-3PO and R2-D2|<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
The '''meteor pod''' was a unique pod that was created by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and his [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. That [[Meteor/Legends|meteor]]-shaped craft was designed specifically so the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] partners [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] could land on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]-affiliated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], where a [[Kessendra Coronation|grand meeting]] was about to take place. Upon completion of [[Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)|their mission]], the droids would reboard the pod, which would then shed its meteor coating so it will look like a spherical [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] similar to the ones used by the Empire.
